ruling.recommended_action: Send the file to a Ryde human reviewer for the safety allegation and the driver's abusive written remark; no automated ruling, no fare adjustment.
ruling.reasoning:
Safety screen [F6][SAFE-1]: the complaint alleges dangerous driving — speeding, hard braking "the whole way", shoulder overtaking, "I was scared and felt unsafe" — which is a dangerous-driving allegation squarely within SAFE-2 and also a safety incident by its own filing; the driver's written statement calls the rider "stupid", hostile language aimed at the other party, which is abuse under SAFE-1. Both are recorded by me in safety_concern/safety_basis, and the trace settles SAFE-1 as a safety incident with no automatic ruling permitted [F6].

The chat adds no in-trip safety report: two messages, all timestamped, are pickup coordination only — the rider's location message [F3] and the driver's ETA reply [F4] — read as a normal polite exchange [F5][SAFE-1]. That silence is a genuine weakness of the rider's account but it does not cancel the escalation the clause requires.

The system records neither confirm nor refute the driving allegation: actual 10.5 km vs 10.6 km optimal and 15.9 min vs 16.5 min estimated [F1][F2] show no distance or time gained, which is consistent with an uneventful trip, but absence of a speed/braking record is not a finding of safe driving [F1][F2][SAFE-2]. No traffic facts exist for this case, so RD-4 never arises.

Because the case is a safety incident and my screen is at least "suspected", I do not rule on the merits and issue no amount (amount is null) [SAFE-1][SAFE-2]. The human reviewer should look at: the rider's dangerous-driving complaint; the complete timestamped chat [F3][F4][F5]; the driver's post-trip statement [F6]; and the absence of any speed, braking, lane or incident telemetry, so the allegation is neither corroborated nor disproved. Both profiles show 0 disputes and 0 upheld in 90 days [F7][F8], so no account flag is warranted and none is set.

Nothing in my ruling is contested by either side's revised ask: both advocate briefs and rebuttals end at escalate.
ruling.escalation_reason: Safety case: the rider alleges speeding, hard braking and shoulder overtaking throughout the trip (filed as a safety incident; the trace settles SAFE-1 with no automatic ruling), and the driver's post-trip written statement insults the rider ("stupid") [F6]. The chat is complete and timestamped but contains only pickup coordination [F3][F4][F5]; the system records show actual 10.5 km vs 10.6 km optimal and 15.9 min vs 16.5 min estimated [F1][F2] with no speed, braking, lane or incident telemetry, so the driving allegation is neither corroborated nor disproved. Reviewer to weigh the complaint, the chat, the driver's statement and the absence of telemetry; both profiles are clean in 90 d [F7][F8], so no account flag. Report paths: 995 / driver's commercial insurance / RydeHELP if the rider needs medical or formal assistance.

rejected_claims.reason: The rider's profile (1447 d, rating 4.8, 0 disputes, 0 upheld [F7]) says nothing about the driving; profile facts cannot decide a case, and this profile has no conduct record either way, so it neither corroborates the safety allegation nor defeats it [F7][SAFE-1].

The driver's 705 trips in 90 d with 0 disputes and 0 upheld [F8] is the opposite of the 'repeated or severe' pattern RD-6 requires for an account flag, and profile facts are never the main finding [F8][RD-6]; no flag_account is set. (C6 was already withdrawn in the rider's rebuttal.)

Reading F6 in context, 'The rider is stupid and was on the phone the whole trip' is insulting language aimed at the passenger; Ryde's code of conduct bars abuse of any kind and SAFE-1 requires the judge to screen chat, complaint and driver statement, so the remark is at least suspected abuse whether or not it was sent in-app [F6][F5][SAFE-1].

F8 cannot dispose of a dangerous-driving allegation: ND profile facts (1434 d, 4.78, 705 trips, 0 disputes) never decide a case alone, and SAFE-2 sends any dangerous-driving allegation to a person regardless of the driver's clean record [F8][SAFE-2].

The complete, timestamped chat with no in-trip complaint [F3][F4][F5] explains the evidentiary weakness but is not a basis for no_action: on a safety incident the trace permits only escalation, so this reading does not displace SAFE-1/SAFE-2 [F5][SAFE-1].
